name: Homestead Loop
note: From the Waterfront along the river to the Pump House, then Eighth Avenue through Homestead and back by Amity St

name: Waterfront Loop
note: The riverfront trail to the Pump House and back along East Waterfront Drive past the shops

name: Two Bridges Loop
note: From the Waterfront up Amity St, over the Homestead Grays Bridge, down Old Browns Hill Road to Duck Hollow and along the Duck Hollow Trail to Hazelwood, back over the Glenwood Bridge and home on the GAP

name: East End Loop
note: From Schenley Park along Forbes into Squirrel Hill, Beechwood Blvd past Mellon Park and Penn Ave past Bakery Square to East Liberty, up N Highland and Stanton Ave to Highland Park, round Lake Carnegie and the reservoir on Lake Drive, down N Highland and back over Shady Ave

name: Squirrel Hill & Bakery Square Loop
note: From Schenley Park along Forbes to Squirrel Hill, down Beechwood Blvd past Mellon Park, Penn Ave past Bakery Square, and the long pull back up Shady Ave

name: Highland Park Reservoir Loop
note: Stanton Ave along the park, Lake Drive past Lake Carnegie and round the reservoir to the zoo gates, past the entrance garden and down N Highland Ave

name: Stanton Heights & Highland Park Climb
note: From Lawrenceville the long steady climb up Stanton Ave over Stanton Heights and N Negley to Highland Park, a lap of the reservoir, and back over the top to Butler Street

name: Three Rivers Loop
note: The whole loop: the Point, downtown, the South Side and the McArdle climb to Grandview

name: Three Rivers Loop · reverse
note: The loop the other way: over the West End Bridge, Grandview and down McArdle first

name: South Side Short Loop
note: Skips the South Side riverfront: right at East Carson & 10th, straight up McArdle

name: South Side Short Loop · reverse
note: Grandview and down McArdle, then left at East Carson & 10th back to downtown

name: South Side Flat Loop
note: East Carson Street and the river trail, round and round from East Carson & 10th

name: Three Rivers Loop + West End Overlook
note: The whole loop with the climb through Elliott to the West End Overlook and back down

name: Jail Trail & South Side Loop
note: From downtown along the Jail Trail, over the Hot Metal Bridge and back on the South Side river trail

name: Point & Jail Trail Loop
note: The Point and downtown, the Jail Trail, the Hot Metal Bridge and the river trail, back by the Smithfield Street Bridge

name: Jail Trail & Mount Washington Loop
note: The flat Jail Trail out, the river trail, then the McArdle climb and Grandview home

name: Mount Washington There & Back
note: Up McArdle, along Grandview to the Water Steps, then back over the top

name: Three Rivers There & Back
note: The whole loop, then the whole loop backwards

name: Schenley Park Loop
note: Round Schenley Park from Phipps: Schenley Drive, Serpentine Drive, the Oval and up Panther Hollow

name: Jail Trail, Oakland & Schenley
note: The Jail Trail, up Junction Hollow to Oakland and the Cathedral of Learning, round Schenley Park and back down to downtown

name: Oakland & South Side Loop
note: The Point, the Jail Trail, Oakland and Schenley Park, then over the Hot Metal Bridge and home on the river trail

name: Allegheny Loop
note: From the Water Steps along the North Shore Trail to Millvale, over the 40th Street Bridge, down Butler Street and through the Strip, home over the Clemente Bridge

name: Allegheny Loop · reverse
note: Over the Clemente Bridge, up Penn Avenue and Smallman Street through the Strip and Lawrenceville, back along the river from Millvale

name: Allegheny & Jail Trail Loop
note: Both rivers on the flat: the Allegheny Loop, the Point, the Jail Trail, the Hot Metal Bridge and the South Side river trail

name: Troy Hill Climb Loop
note: From the 16th Street Bridge along the river to the 31st Street Bridge, straight up Rialto Street (Pig Hill, about 24 %), over Troy Hill and back down Troy Hill Road

name: Water Steps & Troy Hill
note: Out along the North Shore Trail, up Rialto Street to Troy Hill and down Troy Hill Road, back past PNC Park to the Water Steps

name: Allegheny Loop + Troy Hill
note: The Allegheny Loop with a lap of Troy Hill: up Rialto Street at the 31st Street Bridge, down Troy Hill Road, then on to Millvale, Lawrenceville and the Strip

name: Polish Hill Climb Loop
note: From Liberty Ave over the 28th Street Bridge, up Brereton St past Immaculate Heart of Mary and Dobson St, down Herron Avenue's hairpin and back along Liberty

name: Polish Hill, Bloomfield & Oakland Loop
note: From the Strip up through Polish Hill, over the Bloomfield Bridge, through Bloomfield and across to Schenley Plaza; down Junction Hollow, the Jail Trail into downtown and Penn Avenue back to the Strip

name: Allegheny, Polish Hill & Oakland Loop
note: The North Shore Trail to Millvale and Lawrenceville, up through Polish Hill and Bloomfield to Oakland, down Junction Hollow and the Jail Trail, home over the Clemente Bridge

name: Great Allegheny Passage to Homestead
note: From SouthSide Works out the GAP along the Mon to the Waterfront, a lap of Homestead past the Pump House and Eighth Avenue, and back

name: Jail Trail & the GAP to Homestead
note: The Point, the Jail Trail and the Hot Metal Bridge, the GAP to Homestead and a lap past the Pump House, home on the South Side river trail

name: The GAP & Two Bridges
note: From SouthSide Works out the GAP to the Waterfront, Waterfront Drive past the shops to the Pump House, Eighth Avenue through Homestead, over the Homestead Grays Bridge, down to Duck Hollow and the Duck Hollow Trail to Hazelwood, back over the Glenwood Bridge and home on the GAP

name: North Side Hills Loop
note: From the Water Steps: past PNC Park, up Federal Street round Allegheny Center, the Fineview climb and overlook, Riverview Park and the Allegheny Observatory, the Davis Avenue Bridge, down Brighton Road and home along the river

name: North Side Hills Loop · reverse
note: Along the river and up Brighton Road to Riverview Park and the Observatory first, then down through Fineview past the overlook and down Federal Street to PNC Park

name: North Side Hills Loop · from the Clemente Bridge
note: From downtown over the Clemente Bridge straight up Federal Street, the Fineview climb, Riverview Park and the Observatory, down Brighton Road, the river past the Science Center and PNC Park, and back over the bridge

name: Fineview Climb Loop
note: From the Water Steps up Federal Street, up Belleau Street to the Fineview Overlook, down Perrysville Avenue's bends, Randyland and the Aviary, home along the river

name: Three Rivers & North Side Loop
note: The Three Rivers Loop with McArdle and Grandview, over the West End Bridge, up Brighton Road to Riverview Park, down through Fineview, Randyland and the Aviary to the Water Steps

name: Allegheny, East End & Oakland Loop
note: The North Shore Trail to Millvale and over the 40th Street Bridge, up Stanton Ave to Highland Park and round the reservoir, East Liberty and Shady Ave to Squirrel Hill, Forbes to Schenley Park, round the Oval and down through Oakland, Junction Hollow and the Jail Trail, home over the Clemente Bridge

name: Sycamore Street & Grandview
note: From Station Square straight up Sycamore Street (a Dirty Dozen climb) to Mount Washington, over Wyoming St's cobbles to Grandview past the Monongahela Incline, down McArdle and back along East Carson

name: South Side Slopes Climb Loop
note: From East Carson & 27th up the Slopes' Dirty Dozen streets (Barry, Holt and Eleanor), along Arlington's ridge to Allentown, over Bailey Ave to Mount Washington, down Sycamore Street to Station Square and East Carson home

name: Dirty Dozen South Loop
note: Up Sycamore Street from Station Square, across Mount Washington and down to Beechview for Boustead Street and Canton Avenue's cobbles (about 37 %), up Warrington Ave to Allentown, along Arlington's ridge and down the South Side Slopes to East Carson

name: Dirty Dozen South from the Slopes
note: From East Carson & 27th up Barry, Holt and Eleanor to Allentown, over to Mount Washington and down to Beechview for Boustead Street and Canton Avenue's cobbles, back up Warrington Ave and down the Slopes

name: Under the Allegheny: North Shore to the Point
note: From the Water Steps: the escalator down at North Side, the subway path under the Allegheny, up at Gateway, round the Point and the riverfront, home over the Clemente Bridge

name: Stadiums Loop
note: From the Water Steps: up PNC Park's spiral escalator, round the upper deck behind home plate and down its ramp by the Clemente Bridge; round Allegheny Commons to Acrisure Stadium's escalator, its rim with the view to the Point and its ramp down to the river; under the Allegheny by the subway, round the Point and back over the Clemente Bridge (through PNC Park the other way)

name: Three Rivers Loop · via the subway
note: The Three Rivers Loop with the subway under the Allegheny instead of the Clemente Bridge and the Point

name: Long Loop · out by the subway
note: The long loop both ways: out under the Allegheny by the subway, home round the Point and over the Clemente Bridge

name: Tour de Pittsburgh
note: The city's landmarks in one loop from the Water Steps: through PNC Park, Randyland and the Aviary, past Mister Rogers and the USS Requin and through Acrisure Stadium; up Troy Hill past St Anthony's Chapel and Most Holy Name, Millvale and the 40th Street Bridge, Highland Park's reservoir, East Liberty Presbyterian, Shady Ave to Squirrel Hill and through Phipps Conservatory; Schenley Plaza by the Carnegie Museum, Heinz Chapel and the Cathedral of Learning, Soldiers & Sailors, Bloomfield and down past Immaculate Heart of Mary on Polish Hill; St Stanislaus in the Strip, the Point and Fort Pitt, PPG Place and downtown's towers, Station Square and the Mon Incline, up McArdle to the Grandview overlooks and St Mary of the Mount, the Duquesne Incline, over the West End Bridge and home past the Science Center through Acrisure Stadium
